turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My wife, you must rest. Do not worry about such things. I will see to everything and ensure our son is wed as you wish.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will ensure that everything is prepared as you wish, Mother-in-law. Please rest now.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, marry this good woman and let there be life in our house, for I see the end coming. Take care of your father and the fool in the court, and remember your duty to them.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will marry my wife as you wish and take care of Father and the fool in the court. Please rest, your wishes will be fulfilled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must see this through, my son. Marry her now and let there be life in our home before I go.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will arrange everything immediately. Please stay calm and rest.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My wife, do not worry. Our son will marry as you wish, and he will take care of us all. Rest now, for you must stay strong.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you will, my son, but I must see it with my own eyes before I rest in peace. Arrange it quickly.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I understand. I will speak to the priest and arrange the wedding right away. Please hold on a little longer.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, my son. Please do not delay. I must see this, for my heart is heavy with worry.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will make sure everything is prepared, mother. Please do not worry about anything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I trust you, my son. Now go and arrange it without delay. My time grows short, and I yearn to see my wishes fulfilled.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Yes, mother. I will speak to the priest and arrange everything as you wish. Please rest now.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not worry, my love. Our son will see to it, and you will see him wed as you wish. Rest easy, and let us hope for the best.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I thank you, husband, and you, my son. Now is the time to act, for the sun sets on my days. Let us not waste what little time remains.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I shall do my utmost, mother. I will ensure the wedding preparations are swift and proper.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am grateful for your efforts, eldest son. Now, let us not delay further. I must see this through, for my peace of mind and the future of our family.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will begin the arrangements immediately, mother. Please try to rest while I attend to these matters.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, son. Now go, and do not let anything hinder your efforts. I must see this through, for my peace and the family's future.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will not let you down, mother. I will speak with the maid and ensure everything proceeds as you wish.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
